verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a project-management SaaS like Shortcut, but the evidence shows no Shortcut-owned CLI. The CLIs mentioned (Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI) are third-party agent tools that connect through Shortcut's MCP server, and the REST API is only a developer building block, so neither counts as an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
